question: What is the meaning of ability of the product to improve air quality by pollutant capture in relation to environmental benefits?
data_point: ability of the product to improve air quality by pollutant capture
description: The ability of the product to improve air quality by pollutant capture refers to the product's capacity to enhance the air quality by trapping pollutants present in the environment. This aspect focuses on the product's capability to capture harmful substances from the air, thereby contributing to a cleaner and healthier atmosphere.
